description: E3b arm D -- refinement at 3 blocks
observations: A refinement stack trained at 3 residual blocks matches six-block H2 at the same budget, seed and recipe, and stays stereo-functional.
one seed; 160 training scenes from random initialisation, so no transfer to a pretrained model is implied. MACs are arithmetic, not latency.
Stereo dependence is RECORDED at epochs 10 and 100 and JUDGED only at epoch 200 -- never gated before epoch 20, per EXP-H2-EMERGENCE-001.
conclusion: Arm D (3 blocks): 200 epochs; late-window EPE 3.7694673344787275 D1 26.940184403396664; matching gradient 100.0% of 16000 batches; no abort.
